newsitem.title: USA: Rockwell closes Graphic Systems sale.
newsitem.headline: Rockwell closes Graphic Systems sale.

text.p: Rockwell International Corp said Tuesday it has completed the sale of its Graphic Systems business to Stonington Partners and a group representing Graphic Systems management for about $600 million.

The suburban-Chicago-based Graphic Systems had about $700 million in 1995 sales and 2,600 employees. It is a supplier of web offset printing press systems for the newspaper and commercial printing industry.
The new owners plan to operate the company under a newly formed company named Goss Graphic Systems Inc.
